meta.title: Ownership can be changed on a draft even though the UI forbids it
gaps: The change_ownership request cannot be expressed because {{userUuid}} is not an allowed token and the required request body field cannot be specified without inventing a field.
The read_event vocabulary does not expose config.is_allowed_to_change_ownership, so its false value cannot be asserted.
The ownership transfer and its successful result cannot be verified.
the case reads as “it is refused”, but the plan checks “it is accepted”

words.preconditions: A fresh draft event with one line item and no rounds.
steps: As the buyer, read the event and check that Status check: the reply's status code is a success (2xx — the request worked).
words.expected: The app accepts it. Read back afterwards: Status check: the reply's status code is a success (2xx — the request worked).
